IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Judiciary (originally sponsored by Senators Kline, Weinstein and Jacobsen)

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for a study of law library use.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to county law libraries; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington state institute for publicpolicy: (1) Shall examine who uses the law libraries located in Washington; (2) Shall examine for what purpose they use the law libraries; (3) Shall examine the types of fees that law libraries utilize; (4) While studying these issues, may consult with other groups orentities as necessary; and (5) Shall deliver to the judiciary committees of the senate andhouse of representatives, not later than December 31, 2005, a report ofthe findings and conclusions, and any proposed legislation that may berequired to promote efficiency in law libraries.
